easyPrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Marvin using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.
